title: Coverage-Terminated Balances — Treatment on a Medical Hardship Supplement
content:
Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), the coverage-terminated balance of the coverage-gap account is taken off the medical debt a hardship supplement claims in one of three ways.

**The coverage-gap account** is the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account carrying the patient's most recent coverage-terminated liability (an amount an insurer released because coverage had ended before the date of service; on a same-day tie, the liability listed first in the account activity). **Its coverage-terminated balance** is its coverage-terminated liabilities of the twelve months less every uninsured discount of the twelve months posted on the coverage-gap account (a discount granted on those liabilities after coverage ended included). Coverage-terminated liabilities on any other account stand as posted. A whole month runs from a day of one month to the same day of the next month or, when the next month has no such day, to the first day of the month after it; a posting belongs to the twelve months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posting date from the signing day, so that a posting dated on the signing day's day of the month twelve months earlier is already outside.

| Condition | Taken off |
|---|---|
| the patient holds a BadgerCare Plus (Wisconsin Medicaid) Claim under Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) | all of that balance |
| the patient holds no BadgerCare Plus claim, a BadgerCare Plus determination notice has been accepted on the case, and the coverage-gap account is coded emergency or medically necessary | the part of that balance above the amounts-generally-billed share of those liabilities — the program's amounts-generally-billed percentage (34.6 percent on every tier) of them, rounded half-up to the cent — nothing coming off a balance already at or below that share |
| otherwise, including when the coverage-gap account is coded elective | nothing |

### Worked example (hypothetical)

Coverage-terminated liabilities of the twelve months on the coverage-gap account: 1,000.00; an uninsured discount of 400.00 posted on that account in the twelve months; balance 600.00. The amounts-generally-billed share of the liabilities is 34.6 percent of 1,000.00, that is 346.00.
- No BadgerCare Plus claim, an accepted determination notice, a medically necessary account: 600.00 less 346.00, that is 254.00, is taken off.
- A BadgerCare Plus claim held: the whole balance, 600.00, is taken off.
- Same as the first case but with uninsured discounts of 700.00 (balance 300.00, at or below 346.00): nothing is taken off.
- No determination notice accepted on the case and no BadgerCare Plus claim: nothing is taken off.
